transcript:
Agent: Hello, thank you for calling TechSolutions SaaS Support. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi, Sarah. I’m having trouble with my billing. I’ve been charged twice this month, and I don’t understand why.

Agent: I’m sorry to hear that, and I can definitely help you clarify that. Can you please provide me with your account email so I can take a look?

Customer: Sure, it’s john.doe@email.com.

Agent: Thank you, John. One moment while I pull up your account… Okay, I see the issue. You were charged for both your standard Pro plan and an add-on you subscribed to last month.

Customer: I didn’t mean to subscribe to the add-on. I thought I was just trying it out.

Agent: I understand that can be confusing. The add-on does have a 30-day trial, but if it’s not cancelled, it defaults to auto-renew. Would you like to cancel that add-on and process a refund for this charge?

Customer: Yes, please. I’d appreciate that.

Agent: Absolutely, I’ll take care of that for you right now. The refund should be processed within 3-5 business days.

Customer: Thank you! I really appreciate your help with this.

Agent: Of course! Is there anything else you need help with today?

Customer: I was actually curious about the new features in your latest update. Are there any new integrations available?

Agent: Yes! Our latest update includes seamless integration with Zapier and enhanced reporting tools. Would you be interested in upgrading to our Premium plan to access these features?

Customer: I’ll have to think about it, but that sounds interesting.

Agent: Totally understandable! Feel free to reach out if you have any more questions about the Premium plan. 

Customer: Will do! Thanks again for your help, Sarah.

Agent: You’re welcome, John. Have a great day!
